info.title: Upgrads CRM – Engine API
info.summary: What the Upgrads Onboarding Engine reads and writes in the CRM, and the webhooks the CRM sends to the Engine.
info.description:
Implements §5.1–§5.4 and §8 of the *CRM Integration for the Onboarding Engine — Developer Briefing* (v01, September 2026).

**Authentication.** One API key per CRM workspace, created on the CRM's Integrations → Upgrads Engine → *API keys* card and shown once. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` (or `X-API-Key: <key>`). Every failure is the same `401 nicht_authentifiziert`. A key sees only its workspace: a `kunde_id` of another workspace is `404`, never `403`.

**Ids.** `kunde_id` is the CRM contact id (integer) — the same value the webhooks carry.

**Errors.** Always `{ "fehler": { "code", "nachricht" } }` with a meaningful status; never HTTP 200 with an error body. Unknown paths under `/api/kunden` and `/api/dokumente` are JSON `404 nicht_gefunden`.

**Idempotency.** Every write requires an `Idempotency-Key` header (≤ 255 chars). Same key + same body within 24 h replays the stored answer with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`; same key + different body → `422 idempotency_key_konflikt`; still running → `409 anfrage_in_bearbeitung`.

**Rate limit.** 300 requests per minute per source IP across `/api/kunden` and `/api/dokumente` → `429 zu_viele_anfragen` with standard `RateLimit-*` headers.

**Timestamps.** ISO 8601 in UTC.

**akte_version.** A counter the CRM increments on every accepted master-data write from any side (Engine `PATCH`, a CRM user's edit, the lead webhook). Send the version you last read as a precondition on `PATCH /api/kunden/{kunde_id}`; a stale value is `409 akte_version_konflikt`.

**Webhooks** (see the `webhooks` section): POST to the URL configured in the CRM, body = the envelope `{ event, event_id, zeitpunkt, kunde_id, daten }`, header `X-Upgrads-Signature` = lower-case hex HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body with the workspace's webhook secret (no prefix, no timestamp). Retries: 7 attempts (immediately, +1 min, +5 min, +30 min, +2 h, +6 h, +16 h ≈ 24.6 h) on network errors, timeouts, 5xx, 408, 429; identical bytes and `event_id` each time. Answer 2xx quickly.

**Platform switch.** The CRM's platform administrator can switch the Engine API off for every workspace; every call then answers `503 api_deaktiviert` with `Retry-After`. Outgoing webhooks can be held back the same way: events are recorded and sent, with their original `event_id`, once switched on again. A malformed JSON body is `400 ungueltige_daten`; a body over 100 kB is `413 anfrage_zu_gross`.

host.description: The CRM's public origin (BASE_URL of the deployment).

tags.name: Kunde
tags.description: Master data and onboarding status of a customer (CRM contact).

tags.name: Dokumente
tags.description: Contracts, call recordings and other files the team uploaded on a customer.

tags.name: Notizen
tags.description: Sales-call notes out, Engine result logs in.

tags.name: Kommunikation
tags.description: Hand-logged e-mails / WhatsApp messages (the CRM has no mailbox).

patch.summary: Add master data the Engine identified — fills EMPTY fields only (§5.2 write)
patch.description: Never overwrites a populated field. A populated field with a different value is reported in `konflikte` and written as a note on the customer; equal values (case for email, surrounding whitespace) are ignored. `null` / `""` mean *nothing to add* (the Engine cannot clear a field). An empty `email` is filled only if no other contact of the workspace has it (`grund: email_vergeben` otherwise). Unknown keys → 422. When at least one field is written, `akte_version` increments by one.

200.description: The customer after the write, plus what was written and what conflicted.

patch.summary: Set the onboarding status (§5.3) and the linkage fields (§5.4)
patch.description: The status is the Engine's field: the CRM only displays it. `drive_ordner_id` and `akte_version` are touched only when present; `drive_ordner_id: null` clears it. Never triggers an outgoing webhook.

parameters.name: dokument_id
parameters.description: `id` from a document listing or a `dokument.hinzugefuegt` event.

get.summary: The file: 302 to a signed link valid 10 minutes (§5.2 "a time-limited link is acceptable")
get.description: Follow the redirect to receive the bytes. Do not store the signed URL — call this endpoint again when you need the file again.

302.description: Redirect to the signed storage URL.

get.summary: Notes and call logs of the customer (§5.2 "sales call notes")

200.description: Newest first. `quelle: engine` marks your own notes.

post.summary: Write an Engine result log as a note on the customer (§5.2)
post.description: Appears on the customer in the CRM at once, signed "Upgrads Engine". Plain text with `\n` line breaks. Never triggers an outgoing webhook.

get.summary: Hand-logged e-mails and WhatsApp messages (§5.2) — with a limitation
get.description: The CRM has no mailbox. Entries are what a team member logged by hand: `inhalt` and `zeitpunkt` are real; `betreff`, `richtung`, `absender` are always `null`; `erfasst_von` names who logged it. Every answer carries a `hinweis` saying so.

post.summary: A contract was signed — start onboarding (§5.1)
post.description: Fires when a deal moves into one of the workspace's trigger stages (board drag, deal form, the Onboarding monitor's *Start onboarding* button). Not sent for a deal without a contact (logged as failed in the CRM instead). `daten.unterschrieben_am` comes from a deal field `unterschrieben_am` or the date of the move in the acting user's timezone; `laufzeit_monate` from a deal field or null; `dokument_url` is the newest `vertrag` document of the customer or null.

A contact of type customer was created in the CRM (by a user or by the inbound lead webhook), or a supplier was re-typed as a customer. The bulk CSV import does not fire. `daten` = the master data as `GET /api/kunden/{id}` would answer it, plus `erstellt_am`.

One of the master-data fields changed through a user edit or the lead webhook. Assignee, custom fields, notes, deals and the Engine's own writes never fire. `daten.geaendert` lists the changed fields by their `daten` names (`adresse` for any address part).

post.summary: A document was uploaded on a customer (§5.1)
post.description: Fetch the bytes through `daten.download_url` (= `GET /api/dokumente/{id}/download`) with your API key. `vertrag_id` is the deal the team linked the file to, or null.

post.summary: Connectivity test from the CRM's Integrations page
post.description: Sent once when an owner clicks *Send test event*. Same envelope and signature; `kunde_id` is null and `daten` carries the workspace id. Answer 2xx.

bearerKey.description: `Authorization: Bearer <api key>` — the key from the CRM's API keys card.

KundeId.name: kunde_id
KundeId.description: CRM contact id — the `kunde_id` of the webhooks.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Unique per intended request. Same key + same body within 24 h replays the stored answer (`Idempotent-Replayed: true`).

Seit.name: seit
Seit.description: ISO 8601 date or instant; lower bound on when the entry was logged.

XUpgradsSignature.name: X-Upgrads-Signature
XUpgradsSignature.description: Lower-case hex HMAC-SHA256 of the exact raw request body with the workspace's webhook secret. No prefix, no timestamp. Compare in constant time. Replay protection = your idempotency on `event_id`.

BadId.description: `ungueltige_id` — the id in the path is not an integer.

Unauthorized.description: `nicht_authentifiziert` — key missing, malformed, unknown, revoked or expired (always the same answer).

NotFound.description: `nicht_gefunden` — not in this key's workspace, or an unknown path.

InProgress.description: `anfrage_in_bearbeitung` — the first request with this Idempotency-Key is still running.

TooLarge.description: `anfrage_zu_gross` — the request body is over the limit (100 kB).

Disabled.description: `api_deaktiviert` — the platform administrator has switched the Engine API off. `Retry-After` names when to try again; nothing is lost.

OnboardingStatus.description: §5.3 — maintained by the Engine; default kein_onboarding.

akte_version.description: Optional precondition: the version you last read.

grund.description: Present when an empty email could not be filled because another contact has it.

drive_ordner_id.description: Sets it; null clears it; absent leaves it.

akte_version.description: Sets the counter to this value (absent leaves it).

download_url.description: `GET /api/dokumente/{id}/download` on the CRM origin — call it with your API key.

quelle.description: Who wrote it: a person in the CRM, or the Engine.

vertrag_id.description: The deal the note was written on, if any.

erfasst_von.description: The team member who logged the entry.

event_id.description: UUID, unique and stable per delivery — identical on every retry. Deduplicate on it.

kunde_id.description: CRM contact id; null only on test.ping.
